# Workflow catalog

<!-- generated by `python -m omi workflows`; do not edit -->
- omi-flow-bugfix: Fix a defect at its root cause: failing test first, root-cause fix across all callers, regression test, independent review, automatic acceptance on review PASS. Use for a reported bug with a reproducible symptom; use feature for new behaviour. [plan > reproduce > fix > review > accept] [~743 tokens]
- omi-flow-change-request: Handle a scope or requirement change after a task was approved: impact on tasks and cost, options with one recommendation, PO decision in decisions.md, then replan. Use when the PO changes their mind or an engineer reports NEEDS SCOPE; no work starts before the decision. [impact > options > decide > replan] [~659 tokens]
- omi-flow-docs-only: Documentation-only change: docs-writer, then PO check; no reviewer (CI still runs). Use only when every changed path is under docs/**, .omi/tasks/** or is .omi/decisions.md; any other path needs feature. [plan > write > accept] [~468 tokens]
- omi-flow-feature-sensitive: Feature touching auth, secrets, permissions, data, CI or the agent harness: architect design first, then implement, review, security review, PO acceptance. Use only for that risk; plain feature is enough otherwise. [plan > architect > build > review > security > accept] [~620 tokens]
- omi-flow-feature-ui: Feature with a UI change: PO-approved static HTML mockups first, then implement, review, browser QA with screenshots, automatic acceptance on review PASS. Use when screens or interaction change; plain feature is enough for backend or non-visual work. [plan > design > approve-mockup > build > review > qa > accept] [~1081 tokens]
- omi-flow-feature: Default build path for one product change: plan, implement, independent review, automatic acceptance on review PASS. Use for any normal feature or fix; use feature-ui if the UI changes, feature-sensitive for auth, secrets, data or CI. [plan > build > review > accept] [~555 tokens]
- omi-flow-incident: Respond to something broken after a release or gate: contain, diagnose the root cause, hotfix or rollback, then a postmortem note. Use when production, a release candidate, CI gate or ruleset broke; the production merge stays a PO gate. [contain > diagnose > hotfix > merge-prod > postmortem] [~839 tokens]
- omi-flow-promote: Promote an accepted staging candidate - staging -> main PR, then the v<YYYY.MM.DD> tag after the PO merges. Use after the PO merged the release PR into staging and accepted it. [promote > merge-main > tag] [~785 tokens]
- omi-flow-refactor: Restructure code without changing behaviour: tests green before, change, tests green after, independent simplify review, automatic acceptance on review PASS. Use when behaviour must stay identical; use bugfix or feature if behaviour changes. [plan > baseline > refactor > review > accept] [~723 tokens]
- omi-flow-release: Prepare a UAT release candidate - rc tag and the development -> staging PR with Vietnamese notes, test guide and rollback. Use when development has unreleased work; the PO tests and merges, then run omi-flow-promote. [candidate > pr > merge-staging] [~832 tokens]
- omi-flow-spike: Time-boxed research question: researcher gathers cited findings, docs-writer saves the report under docs/, PO decides. No product code. Use to answer a question or compare options; use feature once the decision is made. [plan > research > write > decide] [~493 tokens]
